_comment: Example restrictive policy. Without a policy file nothing is restricted. Keys starting with _ are comments; unknown keys are an error.
_allowed_modules_note: Empty or missing = all modules allowed.
_directories_note: Checked for copy/template dest and file path. Blocked wins over allowed.
_blocked_commands_note: Plain substrings of shell/command commands, not regular expressions.
_strict_note: true adds heuristic checks: command chaining/substitution, rm -rf and similar patterns anywhere in a task, system users/groups, '..' in paths.
